metadata.description: Team marketplace carrying a Gopuff plugin that connects Grok Bot to Gopuff's official MCP server.

plugins.name: gopuff
plugins.description: Shop Gopuff from Grok Bot through Gopuff's official MCP server. Sign in with your Gopuff account; Gopuff handles the sign-in, and your searches, carts, and orders go to Gopuff under that account, so any order you place is charged and delivered like a normal Gopuff order.
